angle: Movement translation, DL (clearest of five groups screened): each rusher's tracked Combine 40 start laid over his own random NFL pass-rush starts (combine_frames vs game_frames_sample). The curve does not translate after size (rho 0.07, noise-corrected 0.12, posterior P(true >= 0.5) = 0.03); agreement between the official 40 time and the NFL first step does explain pressure beyond pick, tested as a held-out shortlist and, new this round, frozen after 2024 and scored on 2025 against a persistence forecast.
metric_name: Speed that translates (the 'Both' call): NFL first step (mean speed 0.3-0.5 s after first movement on ~20 random sampled pass rushes, alignment-adjusted, after weight and EDGE share) in the top third AND official 40 time in the top half; cut-offs for each class set on the other two classes
headline_number: Pool = 69 DL with 100+ rushes and 8+ sampled starts. Shortlist beats the held-out pick/weight/role pressure forecast 8 of 10 vs 16 of 59 (gap 53 pts [28, 75]). Time-forward (frozen after 2024, scored on 2025 vs a forecast that knows each rusher's own 2023-24 pressure): 6 of 7 vs 6 of 16 (gap 48 [15, 75]); continuous slope beyond persistence +0.4 pts/sd [-0.5, 1.3].
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round_13/cand_3 (7.98; its figures were missing at judging, now regenerated and checked). Applied the round-13 top_changes by analogy: (1) the pool is stated once at the top and used throughout; (2) new time-forward test with a persistence baseline (call frozen from 2023-24 starts only, scored on 2025 against a forecast that knows the rusher's own past pressure) plus a no-tracking persistence shortlist for comparison; (3) the checks collapse into one 5-row robustness table (main, forecast knows 40+NGS, sampled snaps removed, day-3/UDFA only, time-forward) with rusher-resampled gap intervals; (4) null bounds for translation: disattenuated estimate and a flat-prior posterior; (5) p values, ridge and window-selection detail moved to the appendix; (6) a 2026 shortlist table (11 names) and an explicit rule-vs-tape decision case (Maason Smith); (7) real motivation section; 'frozen and hashed' phrasing removed; (8) Fig 1 rebuilt as a 2x2 of four rushers on one scale with 13-pt in-panel readouts; Fig 3 labels de-collided with leader lines and panel B reduced to the five table rows; Fig 2B p labels removed. 4 figures + 4 tables; check.py 1,845 words, wc -w 1,995.
open_risks: The two-signal form was chosen in round 12 after seeing all three classes; only the cut-offs are held out. The time-forward row (23 rushers, 7 shortlisted) overlaps the main shortlist and its continuous slope interval includes zero
Against a forecast that already knows the 40 time and NGS get-off the shortlist edge shrinks (6/10 vs 15/59, shuffle p 0.07); on sacks and in the day-3 pool (3 shortlisted) it is not significant
The angle's literal question (does the drill curve translate?) is a null; the tracking contribution is the NFL first step, the Combine contribution is the stopwatch
wc -w is 1,995, close to the 2,000 limit if Kaggle counts table text and captions
The 2026 list includes Ty Robinson on 55 rushes; board actions are football judgement, not model output
